scientific_integrity: Exact finite integer covariance certificate, independent enumeration of orders four through seven, and an analytic m-dependent central limit proof. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random permutations with fixed consecutive window length four; joint Gaussian limit at square-root-n scale, rank and kernel only. No generalization to longer patterns or correlated inputs is claimed.
title: Complete covariance-kernel classification for consecutive four-pattern counts
